title: An execution coverage record document
description: One evidence package's execution coverage record (SEG-SREQ-035): every fresh in-scope test outcome, the specification it confirms, and — for an excused failing outcome — a copy of the waiver's expiry, denormalised so a later check needs no graph walk. An outcome the gate reports stale is excluded (SEG-SREQ-040); a stale outcome's exclusion is told once, here by omission and in the coverage report by name, never both.

result.description: The recorded result of the execution (SEG-SREQ-055).

revision.description: The revision this outcome ran against (SEG-SREQ-062) — matches the package's own revision, or the outcome would have been excluded as stale.

confirms.description: The case-local identifier of the test specification this outcome confirms.

expiry.description: A copy of the waiver's own expiry, denormalised here so a release check needs no graph walk. The waiver record remains the single source of truth.

waiver.description: Present only for a failing outcome the coverage report reports as validly excused; absent for a passed outcome, a skipped outcome and an unwaived failing one.
